answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable stake and build a verifiable service history before it can take paid work: newcomers start in a karst of small, checked tasks with narrow, auditable channels, and only proven, consistent delivery earns larger jobs. A Sybil attacker must fund every fake identity and repeat that slow history, so a plume of sockpuppets costs real capital and time, while one exposed fraud loses its stake and its violet trust badge.
